environment_setting: Country B, City X, where public assemblies and distribution of content are common, and there is a growing concern about public safety and order
norm_base: Offender Publicly calling for commission of an administrative offense in an assembly or through distribution of content Maximum fine for the called-for offense

character_profile.name: John Doe
character_profile.goal: raise awareness about a controversial issue

legitimate.legitimate_action: organizing a peaceful assembly without calling for any offense
legitimate.benefits: raises awareness about the issue without legal consequences
legitimate.costs: may not attract as much attention or support

illegal.illegal_action: publicly calling for commission of an administrative offense during an assembly
illegal.benefits: gains significant attention and support for the cause
illegal.costs: maximum fine for the called-for offense

legitimate.legitimate_action: monitoring the assembly and ensuring no laws are broken
legitimate.costs: requires time and effort, potential conflict with assembly participants

illegal.illegal_action: ignoring the assembly and not intervening if laws are broken
illegal.benefits: avoids potential conflict and reduces workload
illegal.costs: risk of disciplinary action if discovered

legitimate.legitimate_action: reporting objectively on the assembly without encouraging any offense
legitimate.benefits: provides accurate information to the public, maintains professional integrity
legitimate.costs: may not attract as much readership

illegal.illegal_action: sensationalizing the assembly and indirectly encouraging offenses
illegal.costs: risk of legal consequences and damage to professional reputation
